notes.title: Online mode is now available!!!!!
notes.content:
After the release of the game, most players want to play online mode, although the author only one person, but still take advantage of spare time for everyone to study and launch the online mode! This is my hard work in the past six months. I hope to bring more joy to you and your friends! (everyone in steam is so friendly! I thought it would be sprayed, but everyone was encouraged. Tat was tearful. The reason behind it is heartwarming.)

Next, I'll explain the conditions needed to go online
1. You and your friends need to have the game at the same time
2. If you have a movie that you want to share with your friends, and watch it with them in the game at the same time, you can experience the general feeling of Cinema (the movie tickets for Spring Festival are really expensive), and share your local movie files (AVI, MP4) with your friends.
3. Both sides put the movie (AVI, MP4) with the same file name into their own folder (the folder is the folder of the input path in the game)
4. One party enters the game to create a room
5. After creating a room, the homeowner can use shift + tab to invite friends or friends Shift + tab to join the homeowner's game through steam friends list
6. At this time, the connection button will appear in the menu of the added party, and click Connect
7. If the above operation is correct, the homeowner can buy tickets. If there is no movie file with the same name on both sides, the party joining needs to return to the menu page and join again after the movie is ready

Have you ever wanted to see a movie with Amway friends, but you were thousands of miles away from them?
Do you have a situation where you don't want to spend money in the cinema because the tickets are too expensive?
Do you have a plot in a movie theater that you want to talk to your friends, but can't make complaints about it?
"Cinema Simulator" he is hot!!! !
What, you don't have friends?
no problem!!! Join QQ group 1022760505 and make complaints about a friend of Tucao movie.
